entities.name: Domestication of the Horse
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Horses were domesticated on the Eurasian steppe, initially for milk and meat. By ~3,500 BCE, humans were riding them. The horse multiplied human speed 5x and transformed warfare, trade, and migration.
